**WorldPainter's River layer comes in.** A WorldPainter map whose rivers were painted with its River layer lost them when opened in Massif: the layer was listed as not imported. It is now dug where it was painted, as WorldPainter's own export digs it: the water two blocks under the ground, the bed four to seven blocks under the water and shallower towards the edges, joining a lake or the sea nearby at its level. Exported, its ground and water match WorldPainter's own export to the block in 78 of 80 columns checked along a river (the other two a block apart). Its bed is Massif's rivers' (gravel, sand in the shallows, clay in patches) with the river biome.
